title: Steam Deck TH12 official Trial 0.02a two-lane A/B/A
control: One observation-independent frozen initial actor and common sampler seed; native RNG unavailable.
camera: Approximately 0.90 s sampling. Brackets bound visible Stage 1 lettering appearance and disappearance.
fps: OCR of game's renderer FPS HUD, sampled after 5 wall seconds, confidence-filtered. Separate from gameplay ticks.
constraints: Two rootless containers (each 2 GiB), private Xvfb displays and software renderer, capped with independent CFS quotas; non-networked.
